```yaml
name: Bump OpenInference Instrumentation Version

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Run daily at 2 AM UTC

jobs:
  bump-instrumentation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests

      - name: Get latest openinference-instrumentation version
        id: get_instrumentation_version
        run: |
          import requests
          import json
          
          response = requests.get('https://pypi.org/pypi/openinference-instrumentation/json')
          data = response.json()
          latest_version = data['info']['version']
          
          print(f"Latest openinference-instrumentation version: {latest_version}")
          print(f"::set-output name=version::{latest_version}")

      - name: Update instrumentation version in pyproject.toml files
        run: |
          find . -name "pyproject.toml" -type f | while read file; do
            if grep -q "openinference-instrumentation" "$file"; then
              echo "Updating $file"
              sed -i "s/openinference-instrumentation.*$/openinference-instrumentation >=${{ steps.get_instrumentation_version.outputs.version }}/" "$file"
            fi
          done

      - name: Create Pull Request for instrumentation bump
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ steps.get_instrumentation_version.outputs.version }}"
          title: "chore: bump openinference-instrumentation to ${{ steps.get_instrumentation_version.outputs.version }}"
          body: "Automated PR to bump openinference-instrumentation version to ${{ steps.get_instrumentation_version.outputs.version }}"
          branch: "bump-instrumentation-${{ steps.get_instrumentation_version.outputs.version }}"

  bump-semantic-conventions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests

      - name: Get latest openinference-semantic-conventions version
        id: get_semantic_conventions_version
        run: |
          import requests
          import json
          
          response = requests.get('https://pypi.org/pypi/openinference-semantic-conventions/json')
          data = response.json()
          latest_version = data['info']['version']
          
          print(f"Latest openinference-semantic-conventions version: {latest_version}")
          print(f"::set-output name=version::{latest_version}")

      - name: Update semantic conventions version in pyproject.toml files
        run: |
          find . -name "pyproject.toml" -type f | while read file; do
            if grep -q "openinference-semantic-conventions" "$file"; then
              echo "Updating $file"
              sed -i "s/openinference-semantic-conventions.*$/openinference-semantic-conventions >=${{ steps.get_semantic_conventions_version.outputs.version }}/" "$file"
            fi
          done

      - name: Add lower-bound pin for google-genai instrumentor
        run: |
          # Add missing lower-bound pin for openinference-semantic-conventions in google-genai instrumentor
          if [ -f "instrumentors/openinference-instrumentor-google-genai/pyproject.toml" ]; then
            echo "Adding lower-bound pin for google-genai instrumentor"
            sed -i "s/openinference-semantic-conventions.*$/openinference-semantic-conventions >=0.1.28/" "instrumentors/openinference-instrumentor-google-genai/pyproject.toml"
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request for semantic conventions bump
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump openinference-semantic-conventions to ${{ steps.get_semantic_conventions_version.outputs.version }} and add lower-bound pin"
          title: "chore: bump openinference-semantic-conventions to ${{ steps.get_semantic_conventions_version.outputs.version }} and add lower-bound pin"
          body: "Automated PR to bump openinference-semantic-conventions version to ${{ steps.get_semantic_conventions_version.outputs.version }} and add missing lower-bound pin (>=0.1.28) for google-genai instrumentor"
          branch: "bump-semantic-conventions-${{ steps.get_semantic_conventions_version.outputs.version }}"
```
